title: Source EPI indicator weights — ingest epi2024weights.csv and rebuild gold_dim_indicator so Weighted EPI Score renders a 0-100 value
description:
Surfaced by the task-055 AC4 spot-check (2026-08-04): Weighted EPI Score renders BLANK in the deployed semantic model because gold_dim_indicator.weight is NULL for all 73 rows (weight_count_nonblank=0). Root cause: silver-to-gold2.Notebook builds gold_dim_indicator via a fallback path (L1136-1157) that hardcodes weight=F.lit(None) because the expected silver_epi{EPI_YEAR}variables table is never built — bronze_ingest_epi downloads only epi2024results.csv, not the variables/weights files. The fallback also flattens `type` to 'indicator' for all rows, losing the EPI / PolicyObjective / IssueCategory / Indicator hierarchy. PRE-EXISTING (git 193f8f2~1 confirms the pre-task-055 measure also used RELATED(weight)); NOT a task-055 regression. task-055's abbrev<>'EPI' double-count fix is correct DAX but moot until weights are sourced.

Fix shape (bronze → silver → gold → redeploy → re-spot-check): Yale publishes epi2024weights.csv (~5 KB) with the full hierarchy: Type (EPI/PolicyObjective/IssueCategory/Indicator), Abbreviation, Weight (relative within parent), NextLevel (parent pointer), and EPI Percent (absolute contribution to the EPI composite — the weight the measure needs for leaf indicators). (1) Bronze: extend bronze_ingest_epi to also download epi2024weights.csv → bronze_epi_weights. (2) Gold: rebuild gold_dim_indicator from the ingested weights — preserve real `type`, populate `weight` = EPI Percent for leaf indicators (Type=Indicator) and NULL for aggregates (EPI composite, PolicyObjective, IssueCategory), set parent_indicator from NextLevel. Retire/supersede the NULL-weight fallback path so the primary path runs against real data. (3) Optionally harden the Weighted EPI Score measure (fact_epi_score.tmdl) to filter type='Indicator' (leaf indicators only) for robustness — not strictly required because aggregates drop out via NULL weight, but explicit is safer than relying on NULL-weight exclusion. (4) Rerun gold, push → fabric-cicd redeploy, re-spot-check via Power BI REST + Erik's Power BI visual.

With leaf-only weights, task-055's measure is confirmed correct: the EPI composite + PO + IC aggregates contribute score*NULL and drop out of both numerator and denominator, leaving a weighted average of the ~58 leaf indicators by EPI Percent = the true EPI composite.
acceptanceCriteria: bronze_ingest_epi downloads epi2024weights.csv and writes it to a bronze table (bronze_epi_weights or silver_epi{EPI_YEAR}variables built from variables+weights) with the source columns: Type, Abbreviation, Variable, Weight, NextLevel, IssueCategory, PolicyObjective, EPI Percent. Verified: the table exists in the lakehouse and has ~73 rows (1 EPI + 2 PolicyObjective + 11 IssueCategory + ~58 Indicator).

gold_dim_indicator is rebuilt from the ingested weights (the NULL-hardcoding fallback path in silver-to-gold2 L1136-1157 is retired or superseded so the primary path runs against real data). The deployed gold_dim_indicator has: `type` with the 4 real values (EPI/PolicyObjective/IssueCategory/Indicator), `weight` populated = EPI Percent for leaf indicators (Type=Indicator) and NULL for aggregates, `parent_indicator` populated from NextLevel. Verified via the deployed semantic model (Power BI REST executeQueries): weight_count_nonblank > 0 (was 0); leaf-indicator rows have non-null weights; EPI composite + PO + IC rows have NULL weights; COUNT(DISTINCT type) = 4.

Weighted EPI Score renders a non-blank value in the 0-100 range in the deployed semantic model (verified via Power BI REST executeQueries after redeploy). Sanity anchor: Avg EPI Score = 46.95; the weighted score must be a plausible weighted average of leaf-indicator EPI scores — not blank, not >100, not structurally impossible. task-055's abbrev<>'EPI' filter is confirmed correct now that weights are leaf-only (PO/IC aggregates drop out via NULL weight).

Erik-gated Fabric attestation: push → fabric-cicd Deploy Fabric Artifacts workflow green; Erik spot-checks the Power BI report — Weighted EPI Score renders a sensible 0-100 value AND EPI Coverage / Countries with EPI Data still render (unchanged, since they consume abbrev='EPI' not weight). Run /work complete task-056 to attest. Update external_data_automation.md to reflect that the weights file is now ingested (the doc's download_epi_data() design listed it as unimplemented).
notes: CREATED 2026-08-04 (/work) from the task-055 AC4 spot-check finding. Weighted EPI Score rendered BLANK in the deployed model (queried via Power BI REST executeQueries against OEMInsightBI_v2 after the 193f8f2 push + green fabric-cicd deploy). Root cause: gold_dim_indicator.weight is NULL for all 73 rows. gold data shape is otherwise correct: 73 EPI indicators (1 composite abbrev='EPI' + 72 sub = 2 PO + 11 IC + ~58 indicators), 180 countries with EPI data, 12016 sub-indicator fact rows + 180 composite rows, Avg EPI Score = 46.95, Countries with EPI Data = 180.

WHY owner=both AND Claude can act first: ACs 1-3 are code (bronze notebook + gold notebook + optional measure) + REST verification against the deployed model — Claude can implement and verify via the Fabric API (az token + Power BI REST executeQueries, as used in the spot-check). AC4 is Erik-gated (push + Power BI visual spot-check). Same shape as task-054 / task-055.

WEIGHTS SOURCE (verified 2026-08-04): https://epi.yale.edu/downloads/epi2024weights.csv — header: Type,Abbreviation,Variable,Weight,NextLevel,IssueCategory,PolicyObjective,EPI Percent. Sample rows: EPI composite (no weight, no NextLevel); PolicyObjective ECO Weight=0.45 NextLevel=EPI; IssueCategory BDH Weight=0.5555556 NextLevel=ECO EPI Percent=25.00%; Indicator MKP Weight=0.12 NextLevel=BDH EPI Percent=3.00%. EPI Percent is the absolute leaf-indicator weight (sums to ~100% across the ~58 indicators) — this is the value for gold_dim_indicator.weight on leaf rows.

WHY leaf-only weights (NULL for aggregates) makes task-055's measure correct: the measure filters source_system='EPI' AND abbrev<>'EPI' (72 sub-indicators = PO + IC + leaf indicators) and does SUMX(score * RELATED(weight)). Aggregates (PO, IC) with NULL weight contribute score*NULL=NULL → excluded from SUMX numerator; SUM(weight) denominator ignores NULLs. Net: weighted average of leaf indicators by EPI Percent = the true EPI composite. No measure rewrite strictly required; optionally harden to type='Indicator' filter for robustness once `type` is real.

DO NOT regress task-055's measure change: the abbrev<>'EPI' filter (exclude the overall composite) and source_system='EPI' filter (exclude WGI) stay. This task adds weights; it does not revisit task-055's double-count fix.

Verification anchor (pre-fix, for contrast): Power BI REST executeQueries (workspace 99e4cc6d-6ec3-49a7-aed9-b69b04a97aa9, dataset f57bdfa4-52c9-47a3-b853-dac1d1f76178) — Weighted EPI Score = BLANK, weight_count_nonblank = 0, type uniformly 'indicator'. Re-query post-fix to confirm weight_count_nonblank > 0, type has 4 distinct values, Weighted EPI Score is a non-blank 0-100 value.
